data.name: Street-Spec: 日本
data.detailed_description:
OVERVIEW

Street-Spec lets you live the Japanese car life of your dreams. Customize your car to perfection and push it to its absolute limits at Japan's most famous driving hotspots. Race through busy streets or drive on the track and enjoy a nostalgic, atmospheric vision of early 2000s Japan.

In its early stages, Street-Spec will offer a mostly open, unrestricted experience. As development continues, more structured career/progression elements will follow.

FEATURES

Deep Vehicle Customization

  • Install a variety of aftermarket parts such as body kits, engine parts, interior parts and more

  • Repaint or transform any part of your car with no limits in the livery editor

  • Import and export custom paint designs from the internet

  • Import custom 3D models to use as aftermarket parts

  • Fine-tune your vehicle’s performance and handling to your personal driving style

Diverse Driving Experiences

  • Drift at Tokyo's industrial areas in the dead of night

  • Beat your best time on the touge

  • Swerve through the dense traffic of central Tokyo

  • Beat your best track times or learn to drift on the track

  • Enjoy dramatic crashes with parts scattering everywhere

  • Choose from a selection of legendary golden era cars

In-Depth Personalization

  • Adjust weather, time of day, and driving conditions

  • Adjust camera and graphics settings

  • Personalize your garage to match your style

  • Play it even on a potato, at the lowest graphics

Unique Development Approach

  • Development is documented in detail from the very start

  • Community has control over the direction of the project

  • The game takes inspiration from modern games, but also classics like NFSU2, Midnight Club, SLRR, or GT4

  • The art style is slightly low-poly and retro, allowing for more content to be produced faster as a single developer

data.short_description: Street-Spec is a simcade car game set in Japan's Kanto region. Customize your vehicle and push it to its limits at Japan's most famous driving hotspots. Race through busy streets or on the track and enjoy a nostalgic, atmospheric vision of early 2000s Japan.
